details: Source records and templates have distinct candidate identities.
Every pre-existing published-proposal field is preserved.
Every existing published-guidance review field is preserved.
Templates contain no invented athlete preferences or supplied limits.
Source guidance, user constraints, and project policies remain distinct.
Proposal fields have not become actual adoption or runtime decisions.
No human reviewer or decision is invented.
Every case references existing candidate contracts.
Every candidate has at least one draft specification; this does not establish exhaustive testing.
Each specification states an expected result and prerequisite contract.
Reduced fixtures have an explicit unit-harness context and do not pretend to be complete athlete profiles.
Draft expectations are not test execution or independent human review.
These cases and answer keys remain outside retrieval and final evaluation profiles.
